text:
samir: FYI rolled out ensemble-selector-v2 to prod at 50% about 10m ago. Early telemetry: p50 down ~6%, p95 down ~10%, token-cost down ~14% on interactive chat traffic. Main win seems concentrated on multi-turn sessions where the selector avoids heavyweight variants.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: release=ensemble-selector-v2 env=prod canary=50% id=rel_2026_03_23_09:20

tomas: nice. any unexpected 4xx/5xx spikes or increased error rates in the router?

samir: no spike in 5xxs. small uptick (+0.2%) in latency variance for long streams (~>512 tokens) but p99 still improved overall. we've got extra traces enabled for the long-stream path.

lia: did the A/B evals catch any regression on structured output / tool-calls? we need to be confident for docs-autofill customers.

samir: ran the structured-output suite against canary and baseline; function-call fidelity unchanged. also ran hallucination-checks on our curated prompts. attaching quick gist with diffs: https://gist.github.com/redwood/ensemble-v2-diffs (private link)

sre-oncall: can we get a rollback play ready if p99 regresses during the evening peak? also want an alert threshold.

samir: rollback is: `rde deploy rollback --release rel_2026_03_23_09:20 --to 0% --force` . Alert: created alert rule `runtime.ensemble_v2.p99 > baseline_p99 * 1.15 for 5m` and wired to #eng-oncall.

tomas: awesome. what's the plan to extend to dedicated pools? any slab/packing settings to tweak?

samir: plan: (1) finish 48h canary; (2) run an 80% blast in a non-peak window next Wed; (3) adapt packing params for dedicated pools (slab-size + prefetch horizon) based on the canary traces; (4) roll to dedicated in two phases.

lia: please add a short note in the runtime runbook about selector fallback behavior (which variant it picks when the metadata is missing). small customers rely on deterministic fallback.

samir: done 1: added fallback note and linked eval artifacts. also created a short retro doc for lessons learned from selector tuning.

sre-oncall: thanks. I'll monitor the evening chart and escalate if we see any tail regressions.

samir: thanks team 389 : will post full postmortem-style summary after 48h and when we complete the blast.

deploy-bot: scheduled load-blast at 2026-03-25T02:00Z for release=rel_2026_03_23_09:20 target=80%

tomas: great work, folks :tada:
note: this file documents a short rollout thread for a runtime selector optimization
